1.label: very_easy
1.summary: 3 foods with seeded heat cues; ±1800 serving tolerance; 1 concurrent start. Each start has a finite cook transition and settles in the golden window.
1.natural_language: Watch the seeded heat response during each finite cook transition and serve every food when its bar reaches its golden window. A settled food remains in that window while you decide. One spoiled item ends the attempt.
